home.job: We are committed to maintaining leadership in the production and export of avocados in Mexico.
home.esf: We strive to provide national and international markets with a top-quality product, exceptional flavor, high food safety standards, and a reliable traceability process from start to finish.
home.prod: Our production is based on efficient and sustainable practices that not only ensure avocado quality but also generate economic benefits for our partners.
home.prom: We promote the development and prosperity of the communities where we operate, reaffirming our social and environmental commitment.
home.desc: Discover our facilities and the actions we take to deliver the highest quality standards.
home.cert: Our certifications reflect our ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and strengthen the trust of our international business partners.

compr.com: We are a committed, responsible, and environmentally conscious company that preserves quality from the beginning of the harvest through every stage of the industrial process, fully complying with all socio-environmental regulations.
compr.vis: To become the leading company in the international market, supported by a comprehensive traceability process that preserves quality from cultivation to export through cutting-edge technology, achieving efficiency, reliability, and scalability in every season.
compr.mis: Our mission is to operate with full commitment across the entire avocado value chain—from cultivation, harvesting, packing, and transportation to direct customer engagement—meeting the highest quality and food safety standards through advanced technology.
compr.val: We are a socially responsible company that promotes inclusion and respects cultural diversity and beliefs. We are primarily defined by the following values:

about.us: We are a pioneer in the avocado industry. Our purpose begins with the selection of the best agricultural land and strategic geographic locations, leveraging diverse climates and altitudes to produce premium-quality avocados at optimal volumes.
about.gpo: Grupo Avohit de México was founded on August 12, 2019, marking the beginning of the development of the Avohit agro-industrial plant in Morelia, Michoacán.
about.us2: We are a packing company committed to local talent and recognize the valuable contribution of Mexican women in the careful handling and selection of our fruit.
about.cal: We have a clear vision of our direction: to deliver the highest quality to our markets while providing an excellent work environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities.
